name: Chapter 3 - Plan Event
brief: Generates plain-text planning steps from an Event Brief using PromptDialog and Azure OpenAI.
description: Chapter 3 demo - Plan Event copilot. User provides the Event Brief (text or Markdown); the copilot returns plain text proposing steps or tasks for how to plan and organize the event. Uses PromptDialog, Azure OpenAI chat completion, and capability registration.
